origin.description: Spectral projected gradient. A box constraint is the default projection. An analytic gradient is checked with numDeriv only when checkGrad asks for it.
origin.usage: spg(par, fn, gr=NULL, method=3, lower=-Inf, upper=Inf, project=NULL, projectArgs=NULL, control=list(), quiet=FALSE, alertConvergence=TRUE, ...)

arguments.name: gr
arguments.text: Analytic gradient. Missing means a one-sided difference with control eps.

arguments.name: control
arguments.text: M, maxit, ftol, gtol, maxfeval, maximize, trace, triter, eps, checkGrad, and checkGrad.tol.

origin.details: Birgin, Martinez, and Raydan spectral projected gradient, including the nonmonotone line search.
origin.value: The same list the R function returns for this case.
